acceptance: Red test first: a fixture FAIL cycle with a floor rejection at minute 30 and 20 more minutes gives fail point 30, waste 20, ratio 0.6.
A PASS cycle gives minutes to ship and no fail point.
evolve wave status (or the quality panel) lists the per-cycle values and the wave median.
The doc of the measure is updated in STE.
fix: From llm-calls.ndjson and the ledger, compute per cycle: LLM minutes to verdict; for a FAIL, the fail point (the first blocking signal: floor rejection, audit FAIL, gate red) and the LLM minutes after it; fail_fast_ratio = minutes up to the fail point / total. Write it into the cycle result and show it per wave next to the L1-L8 baseline.
notes: Builds on #1184 (cyclespend Sum, wavemeasure cost) in batch PR #1198.
source: console, 2026-10-27, operator: "make LLM [minutes] the evaluation on the cycle result; it should fail fast and deliver faster; if not, something is blocking the pipeline; use side indexes". Extends ADR-0158 item 1 (docs/plans/cost-aware-repair-2026-10.md); baseline dev/console-notes/llm-minutes-baseline-2026-10-27.md
summary: The operator evaluates a cycle by LLM minutes: a PASS must deliver fast and a FAIL must fail fast. Today only LLM minutes per shipped cycle exist (ADR-0158 item 1). Wave 143: all 7 FAIL cycles were decided at the build floor but each one spent its correction after that point.
title: Each cycle result carries LLM minutes to verdict, the fail point, the waste after it and a fail-fast ratio
